task_estimates.oversize_justification: All libs/usecase/** carrier/evidence/hidden-gate removals and replacement command surfaces form one compile boundary: splitting them would leave source-only Red identities and/or consumers importing removed compatibility types or the old dispatcher, so no partial usecase batch can pass direct impl-catalog pre-review.

The infrastructure codec and runner/config-loader replacement must remove both source-only legacy providers in the same cutover; splitting the scope would leave source-only Red identities and/or adapters targeting unavailable usecase contracts, so no partial infrastructure batch can pass direct impl-catalog pre-review.
